items.title: Starr confirms post-IQUW leadership structure across London and international lines
items.summary: Starr has finalized its post-acquisition leadership team following its takeover of IQUW, establishing named specialty line heads and a unified London underwriting structure.

items.title: Lockton and Chubb team up for classic and specialist car insurance
items.summary: Broker Lockton has partnered with insurer Chubb to consolidate its specialist vehicle offerings in the UK, introducing fresh policies for classic cars and motorcycles.

items.title: Black Friday ransomware spike exposes retail cyber insurance gap
items.summary: Claims data shows ransomware attacks peak in November, yet fewer than half of smaller UK retailers carry standalone cyber insurance protection.

items.title: Schroder REIT seeks asset sales after Picton discount drives profit surge
items.summary: Schroder Real Estate Investment Trust has reported a one-off profit surge of £100m driven by the Picton acquisition discount, prompting plans to dispose of non-core assets.

items.title: Hoxton Wealth appoints Tom Claridge as inaugural chief investment officer
items.summary: Hoxton Wealth has named Tom Claridge as its first chief investment officer following growth to $5bn in assets under management.

items.title: Optalitix adds agentic AI to quote platform for underwriting automation
items.summary: Insurtech firm Optalitix has integrated agentic AI into its quote platform to automate complex underwriting tasks while maintaining human decision-making control.
